bai: Bai 20 PivotTable trong Excel: Tao Table, Pivot Fields, Values, Layout, PivotChart

cong_thuc.cong_thuc: Chon vung > Insert > Table (Ctrl+T) > My table has headers > dat ten (vd Du lieu)
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Table tu mo rong khi them dong; Pivot dung ten Table lam nguon nen tu cap nhat. Ten lien nhau khong dau.
cong_thuc.vi_du: A1:F4998 thanh Table 'DuLieu'; them 21/3/2020 Mien Nam SP01 30 tu vao Table (vung cham cham)

cong_thuc.cong_thuc: Click o trong Table > Insert > PivotTable > New Worksheet > OK
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Nguon = ten Table; dat o sheet moi. Pane PivotTable Fields + Analyze/Design hien khi click vung pivot.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Source=Du lieu > Sheet moi chua pivot trang

cong_thuc.cong_thuc: Keo Khu vuc>Filters, San pham>Columns, Nha PP>Rows, Doanh thu>Values
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Filters: loc tren; Columns: nhom ngang; Rows: nhom doc; Values: so lieu. Keo ra ngoai hoac bo tich de go.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Filters=Khu vuc (chon Mien Bac), Columns=San pham, Rows=NPP, Values=Sum Doanh thu

cong_thuc.cong_thuc: Click mui ten Values > Value Field Settings > Sum/Average/Count/Max...
cong_thuc.giai_thich: So mac dinh Sum; doi Average/Count tuy muc dich.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Sum->Average xem TB; lai Sum de tong

cong_thuc.cong_thuc: Value Field Settings > Show Values As > % of Grand Total
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Hien ty trong % thay vi so tuyet doi; tong =100%.
cong_thuc.vi_du: SP10 5.24%, SP09 9.16%...; doi ten 'Ty le %' o Formula Bar

cong_thuc.cong_thuc: Chuot phai gia tri > Number Format > Number > Use 1000 Separator, Decimal 0-2
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Them phan cach nghin, so le thap phan cho de doc.

cong_thuc.cong_thuc: Click +/- de thu gon/mo; Design > Subtotals / Grand Totals (Off for Rows&Columns); Show in Tabular Form
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Nut +/- thu gon chi tiet (Mien Bac bao nhieu); Subtotals: tong nhom; Grand Total: tong chung; Tabular: dang bang dep.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Collapse Mien Bac chi thay tong; Grand Totals Off bo dong/cot tong; Show in Tabular Form hien Khu vuc/San pham/Doanh thu

cong_thuc.cong_thuc: Click mui ten field > Sort A-Z/Z-A; Filters bo Mien Bac; Ngay > Date Filter chon 3,6
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Sort san pham tang/giam; loc khu vuc/ngay tuy bao cao.
cong_thuc.vi_du: San pham Z-A; Doanh thu NPP sort nho->lon; Ngay chi 3,6

cong_thuc.cong_thuc: Boi den pivot > Copy > paste o khac (PivotTable Fields theo vung moi); Insert > PivotChart > chon kieu
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Copy nguyen pivot de lam bao cao 2 (theo Khu vuc vs theo San pham); PivotChart ve tu pivot, loc Field Buttons.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Copy pivot sang ben phai keo Khu vuc>Rows; PivotChart cot xem Mien Nam 40%, Mien Trung 35%

cong_thuc.cong_thuc: Click pivot > Analyze > Insert Slicer > tich Nha PP, Ngay > OK; chuot phai Slicer > Report Connections > tich PivotTable1+2
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Slicer loc truc quan (FPT/Ga Excel/Viettel/VNPT); Report Connections cho 1 slicer dieu khien ca 2 pivot; nut Multi-select de chon nhieu; Slicer Options > Columns (2 hoac 4) + keo rong.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Slicer Nha PP 2 cot; chon FPT chi hien FPT o ca 2 bang; frames xac nhan slicer noi FPT/Viettel/VNPT

cong_thuc.cong_thuc: Chuot phai Ngay trong pivot > Group > Months/Quarters/Years; hoac them cot =MONTH(ngay), =YEAR(ngay) lam Slicer
cong_thuc.giai_thich: Ngay le (rat nhieu ngay) kho loc; group theo Thang/Nam hoac chen cot phu Thang/Nam de slicer gon. Video goi y chen cot Thang/Nam.
cong_thuc.vi_du: Them cot Thang=MONTH(A2), Nam=YEAR(A2); Slicer Thang/Nam thay vi hang tram ngay

cong_thuc.cong_thuc: Click pivot > Insert > PivotChart > chon Column/Pie > OK; chuot phai chart > Hide All Field Buttons; Data > Refresh All (+ Change Data Source)
cong_thuc.giai_thich: PivotChart gan voi pivot, loc Field Buttons; them dong vao Table DuLieu xong Refresh de pivot cap nhat; Change Data Source =DuLieu dam bao nguon dung.
cong_thuc.vi_du: PivotChart cot: Mien Nam 40%, Mien Trung 35%; an Field Buttons cho dep; them 21/3/2020 Mien Nam SP01 30 > Refresh thay so moi

cac_buoc: Click o trong vung ~5000 dong > Insert > Table > tich Headers > OK
Doi kieu hien thi + dat ten 'DuLieu' (Name, lien nhau) > Enter
Them dong test: Table tu mo rong (vung cham)
Click trong Table > Insert > PivotTable > New Worksheet > OK
